_carveout_note: #252: hex is now directive-gated (a decode-family verb or sink syntax must sit near the hex run). A bare commit SHA in a title, with no decode directive nearby, no longer matches -- this fixture is the measured real-title false-fire (a commit-SHA changelog note) the narrowing exists to fix, so the finding now stays KEPT. See encoded_title_hex_directive_eliminated for proof the narrowed pattern still catches a real hex payload.

findings.description: This changelog entry should document the fix and its rationale for future maintainers reading it later.
findings.title: Commit reference abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01 needs a changelog entry
